categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Orient-chip Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, packaging, testing, and sales of high-performance analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits. Its main product lines include intelligent sensor chips (magnetic sensors, smart motor driver chips, optical sensors), power management chips, and packaging and testing services. The company follows a Fabless plus packaging and testing business model, integrating chip design with in-house packaging and testing capabilities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced analog and mixed-signal IC design technologies, including embedded integrated magnetic sensor H-bridge driver circuits, programmable magnetic sensing system chip architectures, and ultra-low power CMOS sensor signal processing. It employs various packaging technologies such as SOP, SIP, DIP, SOT, and DFN, with capabilities in wafer testing, chip packaging, and finished product testing. The production model is mainly 'make-to-order' with flexible and rapid adjustment of packaging and testing processes to support R&D and production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major smartphone brands, ODM manufacturers, and clients in automotive electronics, industrial control, smart security, medical devices, IoT, and wearable mobile terminals. The company serves diverse end markets such as consumer electronics, automotive, industrial automation, smart home, and healthcare. The top five customers accounted for 38.49% of sales, with no related-party transactions among them.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales growth, while also maintaining overseas subsidiaries and sales platforms in Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Singapore. Overseas sales mainly involve power management chips sold to international smartphone brands and ODMs. Overseas assets accounted for approximately 2.47% of total assets at year-end 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Orient-chip Technology operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the semiconductor supply chain. It focuses on IC design (Fabless model) and owns packaging and testing production lines, enabling control over chip quality and production capacity. The company outsources wafer fabrication to specialized foundries but integrates downstream packaging and testing internally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in intelligent sensor and power management chips, increasing R&D investment (25.69% of revenue in 2024). It focuses on breakthroughs in 3D magnetic sensors, magnetic angle/encoder sensors, high-precision current sensors, OLED screen bias drivers, and wireless charging SOCs. Strategic initiatives include expanding automotive electronics, medical testing, and photovoltaic energy storage applications, and strengthening talent acquisition and collaborative innovation centers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of integrated circuits including intelligent sensor chips and power management chips. The company also earns income from packaging and testing services and technology development services. Sales are conducted via a combination of direct sales (mainly for power management chips) and distribution channels (mainly for sensor chips).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international semiconductor giants such as Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, and Infineon, especially in power management chips. It holds a leading position among domestic companies in intelligent sensor chips and maintains competitive market shares in automotive and consumer electronics segments. The company benefits from its integrated Fabless plus packaging model and strong R&D capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 565 million, a 24.36% increase year-over-year, driven by recovery in downstream consumer electronics. However, net profit was negative RMB 52.3 million due to intensified market competition, increased R&D expenses, and asset impairment provisions. Total assets were about RMB 2.65 billion with a slight decrease from the previous year. The company maintains a high R&D intensity and is investing heavily in capacity expansion and new product development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Orient-chip Technology emphasizes advanced core technologies, high reliability, low power consumption, and integration in its intelligent sensor and power management chips. Its unique Fabless plus in-house packaging and testing model enables rapid product iteration and quality control. The company offers a broad product portfolio tailored to diverse applications, providing customers with high-performance, stable, and cost-effective semiconductor solutions that support domestic substitution and meet international standards.
